scope: Independent saved-record arithmetic verification only; no field, receiver, case/pose, dynamics, refinement, timing, or experiment rerun.

method.prediction: Exact binary64 equality, matching source ratio-first arithmetic; only saved actual refresh winds enter history.
method.rms: Event-split squared-error trapezoids; independent math.fsum accumulation plus source-order sequential sum cross-check.
method.oracle: Direct comparison of every saved all-vehicle production/independent rotor wind and saved receiver0 loads.
method.timing: Saved timing records only; exact primary-load checksum, call counts, order, min/median/max.
method.comparisonScope: Matched hold5 suite rule is prospective. Hold2.5 comparisons and source-pitch startup decomposition are descriptive saved-record checks.

suiteDecision.scope: Finite selected suite only, not universal superiority or physical validation

sourcePitchPredictorStartup.scope: Descriptive decomposition of saved samples only; no new sampling.

limitations: The matched hold5 suite decision is restricted to these six selected model-input cases; it is not physical validation or a universal predictor advantage.
A suite-relative improvement does not imply passing numerical targets. Source-pitch predictor target failure must remain visible.
Hold2.5 comparisons are descriptive; preserve any peak/RMS losses and report recorded timing with errors.
Event-split RMS is a different, prospectively declared estimand; earlier uniform-RMS failures remain failed.
Exact timing checksums verify the accumulated saved primary loads, not a collision-proof per-query identity proof.
This verifier does not reevaluate the physical/model meaning of saved loads or the analytic case functions.
Technical timing ranges are not confidence intervals. The separate all-pairs static domain audit and frozen source define scope.
